agencyName: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions
authorityRationale: An official NYSED document listing fees across every profession the Office of the Professions licenses (nursing, dentistry, medicine, acupuncture, and dozens more). Genuinely official, but not specific to nursing.
reliabilityRationale: Official but low-specificity: a single 'Endorsement (Relocation): $50' line item with no visible profession label in the excerpted context, inside a chart covering dozens of unrelated professions. Real risk of misattributing a non-nursing profession's fee to nursing if read in isolation from the nursing-specific page.
